    if not intervals:
        return []

    ordered = sorted((list(pair) for pair in intervals), key=lambda pair: (pair[0], pair[1]))
    merged = [ordered[0][:]]

    for start, end in ordered[1:]:
        last = merged[-1]
        if start <= last[1]:
            if end > last[1]:
                last[1] = end
        else:
            merged.append([start, end])

    return merged
